images.name: cover
images.title: *AI order processing*, start to finish
images.sub: Orders read wherever they arrive, checked before they're entered, and the decisions that stay with a person.

images.name: duties
images.title: The order desk, *duty by duty*
rows: Picks up each order from email, the web store, portals and voicemail within minutes.
Runs six checks against the price list, stock and the customer's account.
Saves orders that pass and sends the confirmation with a ship date the same hour.
Sends tracking numbers and answers questions about where an order is.
Edits an order before picking starts. After that, a person decides.
Stops the order and passes it on with the reason and a suggested fix.

images.name: checks
images.title: Six checks *before an order is entered*
head: Check
What it compares
If it fails
rows: The customer's part number against your product list
Asks the buyer which item they meant
The price on the order against that customer's price list
This order against what the customer usually buys
Asks the buyer: cases or units?
The address against the addresses on the account
Stock on hand against the requested date
Credit status, and the PO number against recent orders
images.source: Example. Every business writes its own checks.

images.name: thursday
images.title: A Thursday at a *30-person wholesale distributor*
rows: Enters 19 orders that arrived overnight. All confirmed before picking starts at 7.
A regular who buys 12 cases ordered 144. Asks the buyer: cases or units?
A PO shows last year's price on three lines.
The same PO arrives twice, from the buyer and from payables. Enters it once.
An order comes in from an account on credit hold.
Sends 31 tracking numbers and answers four questions about deliveries.
Two customers want 50 units each. There are 60 in stock.

images.name: setup
images.title: How AI order processing *is set up*
steps: List every way an order arrives
Email, web store, customer portals, voicemail and standing orders.
Each customer's names for your products, taken from past orders.
Product, price, quantity, ship-to, stock, and account status.
It can create orders. It can't change prices or credit limits.
Price overrides, credit holds, substitutions and short stock go to a named person.
Shadow for two or three weeks
It drafts every order while a person approves each one.
